headline: Callahan's Passage Burns as Weathered Expanse Stirs
war_summary: Since the midnight edition the weight of action has shifted from Fisherman's Row to Callahan's Passage and the Weathered Expanse. Fisherman's Row records only two changes in the last two hours against forty-eight on the day about Eidolo, Dankana Post and Arcadia, now standing at eight Colonial to one Warden with casualty rates cooling in the last hour. Callahan's Passage counts twelve changes in two hours and thirty-two on the day about The Latch and The Crumbling Passage, holding at nine Warden to one Colonial with 11,719 Colonial and 13,739 Warden casualties on the day and hourly rates cooling from heavy totals. The Weathered Expanse posts five changes in two hours and forty-four on the day about Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest at two Warden, six Colonial and one neutral, with 9,844 Colonial and 15,862 Warden casualties on the day. Stlican Shelf eases to one change in two hours and forty-one on the day about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost at four Warden to five Colonial. Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow, Mooring County and Nevish Line show no changes in two hours though Nevish Line and Mooring County still carry heavy daily losses.
